songs.title: Let’s Fucking Go!
songs.tags: Hard industrial techno at 160–250 BPM, opening with a single distorted mono synth hit and raw vocal stab. Noisy 303-style acid line with resonant filter automation, overdriven kick pulses, metallic percussion hits, and psytrance-style rhythmic modulation. Voice crushed with distortion, bitcrush, delay throws, and dense reverb for a claustrophobic, relentless, top-quality finish.
